subject.name: Machine Learning
subject.course_or_branch: Mechanical Engineering Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

chapters.chapter_name: Unit 1: Foundations of Machine Learning in Business
content: Introduction to Machine Learning, Learning Systems and Real
world ML Applications, Importance of ML in Business Analytics
Variable Types and Terminology, Function Approximation
Concept of Learning and Types of Machine Learning, Curse of
Dimensionality, Bias-Variance Tradeoff, Overfitting and
Underfitting,, Model Selection Techniques, No Free Lunch
Theorem
Linear Regression, Simple Linear Regression,, Model Accuracy: R2
Logistic Regression, Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Bayes
Theorem, Naïve Bayes Classifier

chapters.chapter_name: Unit 3: Resampling, Regularization, and Tree-Based Techniques
content: Model Evaluation and Resampling Methods,, Cross-Validation:
LOOCV, k-Fold, The Bootstrap Method,, Principal Component
Regression (PCR),, Decision Trees for Classification and
Regression, Advantages and Disadvantages of Decision Trees
EnsembleMethods: Bagging, Random Forest, Boosting

chapters.chapter_name: Unit 4: Support Vector Machines and Applications
content: Concepts of Margins and Hyperplanes,, Maximum Margin
Classifier, Support Vector Classifier, Business Applications
andInterpretation of SVM Models

chapters.chapter_name: Unit 5: Unsupervised Learning for Business Insights
content: Principal Component Analysis (PCA),, Principal Components and
Dimensionality Reduction, Interpreting PCA for Business Data
Clustering Techniques: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Choosing
the Right Number of Clusters,, Use Cases in
CustomerSegmentation, Market Basket Analysis
